answer: You can starve a sybil farm by front-loading its costs. Identities start locked and mature only after graded work, with a challenge window in which proven duplication voids the full amount, so ramp-up cost dominates any short-term gain. In effect the whisper of free entry disappears, the vertex of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the umber case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Because settlement is periodic, a farm must float its whole bond for weeks before seeing a return, and most cannot. The result is that sybils must outspend the network they are attacking,.
